subject: Renewal + expansion: provisioning keys for additional apps
messages:
From: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@craftscale.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@craftscale.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + expansion: onboarding 3 new apps & additional keys

Hi Laura and Vivek,

Quick note — our renewal with Redwood is up in early April. Over the last quarter we decided to expand usage across three additional internal apps (SearchAssist, SupportFlow, and AutoTagger).

High level asks:
- Can we add 6 new API keys (two per app: staging/prod) and stagger provisioning over the next 6 weeks?
- We expect peak concurrency to grow ~3x during the launch windows — what are our options for capacity (burst vs reserved)?
- If we increase our committed capacity, can we discuss term changes/discounts tied to a 12-month commit?

Attached is our recent usage export for Q1 to give you context. Happy to schedule a call this week.

Thanks,
Rajesh
Rajesh Iyer
CTO, CraftScale
[Attachment: craftscale_usage_q1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@craftscale.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: onboarding 3 new apps & additional keys

Hi Rajesh — great to hear about the broader rollout, congrats on the product decisions.

We can absolutely support staged provisioning and a term amendment for committed capacity. Next steps I propose:
1) Quick kickoff call (30m) this week to align on apps, traffic profiles, and timeline.
2) I’ll share a preliminary multiproduct pricing/commitment draft so you can see the delta vs your current plan.
3) Vivek/SE team will outline the provisioning steps and required app details (e.g., callback URLs, intended env separation).

Looped in Vivek, Neha (CS) and Jonas (SE) — can you propose two slots?

Attached: draft_multiproduct_pricing_v1.pdf — this is a working draft and will change after we confirm usage numbers.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft_multiproduct_pricing_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@craftscale.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: onboarding 3 new apps & additional keys

Rajesh / team — thanks, and congrats on the expansion. I captured a rough provisioning & rollout plan below to keep things concrete.

Provisioning & rollout proposal (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + collect app details (name, owner, envs, expected tokens/request) — I'll attach a simple template for you to fill.
- Week 1: Sandbox keys + smoke test for SearchAssist (staging then prod).
- Week 2–3: SupportFlow onboarding (staging, prod) with traffic shaping; enable KV prefix caching for support logs.
- Week 4–5: AutoTagger rollout + load test; move to reserved capacity if peak > configured burst window.

Questions for sizing/pricing:
- For each app: expected P95 tokens/request, average requests/minute during peak, and expected daily active users.
- Any regulatory constraints (data residency/retention) per app?

Attaching provisioning template to collect the above. Once you return it, Jonas and I will configure keys, environments, and a canary rollout cadence.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CraftScale_API_Provisioning_Template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@craftscale.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: provisioning keys for additional apps

Rajesh — a few technical notes to help with sizing and the key provisioning workflow:

1) Keys and env separation
- We recommend issuing one key per environment per app (so staging/prod per app) and applying scoped rate limits. That aligns with your ask for 6 keys.

2) Capacity recommendation (based on your Q1 export):
- Current sustained RPS: ~200
- Projected peak during launches: ~600 RPS aggregated
- Options: 1) Reserved pool for 600 RPS (predictable latency) or 2) Reserved 300 RPS + burst window to 900 RPS (cost-effective if peaks are short).

3) Cost control knobs
- Use per-app token quotas, enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts, and consider int8 quantized variants for bulk inference if you need lower unit cost.

4) Provisioning mechanics
- I can run the key issuance once you return Vivek's template. Keys get delivered via secure link; we can pre-provision sandbox keys earlier if you want smoke tests before signing the amendment.

I’m attaching a quick script we use to automate key creation and policy assignment — you can run this on your infra if you prefer self-service.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: key_provision_script.sh (bash)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@craftscale.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: onboarding and success plan

Rajesh — happy to partner on the rollout. Practical items from CS side:

Onboarding timeline (we can compress if you need faster):
- Week A: Provision sandbox keys + shared runbook; 1-hour smoke test workshop with your eng leads.
- Week B: Prod key issuance for SearchAssist + guided deploy (30–60m).
- Week C–D: SupportFlow + AutoTagger onboarding; training session for product owners (60m).

Success metrics we suggest tracking: latency P95 by app, errors/1000 requests, token spend per DAG, and rollout rollback events.

I can also coordinate dates for training and deliver the onboarding checklist below (attached). If you confirm you want to move to a 12-month committed capacity with the pricing Laura shared, I’ll trigger a pre-launch sandbox set so your teams can start testing.

Regulatory note: if any app requires increased retention or special logging, flag that in the template and we’ll route to our compliance team.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding_checklist.md (text)]

From: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh@craftscale.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: provisioning keys for additional apps

Thanks all — this is perfect. I’ve filled the provisioning template and included the app-level details below:

- SearchAssist (owner: Maya Patel) — peak: 220 RPS, P95 tokens/request: 180
- SupportFlow (owner: Anthony Cruz) — peak: 150 RPS, P95 tokens/request: 240
- AutoTagger (owner: Jin Park) — peak: 180 RPS, P95 tokens/request: 120

We’d like sandbox keys by next Tuesday and a kickoff call on Tuesday afternoon. On the term: yes, we’re open to a 12-month commit if you can provide an updated quote including the reserved capacity option (300 RPS reserved + burst to 900). Please send the amendment and quote and we’ll review with Finance.

Appreciate the quick coordination — talk Tuesday.

Best,
Rajesh
CTO, CraftScale
